title: Requesting a Service Hierarchy Item
body:
Requesting a Service Hierarchy Item

A service hierarchy request consists of a parent item (service-based) and child items related to the service.

Prerequisites

Your administrator must enable the guided buying parameter PARAM_ENABLE_NON_CATALOG_SERVICE_HIERARCHY.

Context

Service hierarchy requests allow you to submit non-catalog requests with multiple items. All the items and services on a service hierarchy request must be grouped under a parent non-catalog service. Child items can be catalog and non-catalog goods or services. For example, you can create a non-catalog request for laptop repair service (parent service) and then add software maintenance service (child service) and computer cleaning kit (child item). Service hierarchies help to define how services are structured and delivered, improving efficiency when ordering services.

You can use service hierarchies in the following scenarios:

  • When you create a service requisition using a non-catalog request or a line item form, you can add child items using the Add Child Item button.

  • On the checkout page, you can add child items to the request before you submit it.

  • If you submit a service requisition, you can withdraw it after it's submitted or partially approved, add or remove child items, and then resubmit it.

Note
Consider the following when working with service hierarchy items:

  • For sites with the 2NV and 3EN integration scenarios, service hierarchy requests are submitted as individual requests. In the future, this feature will be available for sites with the 2NV and 3EN integration scenarios. For more information on requisitions in the 2NV and 3EN integration scenarios, see Requisition Statuses.

  • Service hierarchy requests can be controlled by validation policies, see Configuring Validation Policies.
    Restriction

    Service hierarchy requests cannot be controlled by supplier and touch policies, supplier selection policies, or risk engagement policies.

  • Approvers cannot add child or new hierarchy items at any stage.

  • Forms cannot be added as child items.

  • Hierarchy requests are only applicable for service-based requests using a non-catalog request form. You cannot use other types of forms to request a service hierarchy item.

  • Spot Buy, BMEcat, and inventory items cannot be added as child items for service hierarchy requests.

  • Service hierarchy requests can only have one parent item per request.

  • You can add one level of hierarchy. For example, you can have one parent item and add the child items, but the child items can't have child items.

Procedure

  1. On your dashboard, choose Quick Links  Request a non-catalog item or the plus symbol ().
  2. Choose the Services tab.
  3. In the Service name field, enter a name for the service you need.
  4. For the Category field, choose the category that most accurately describes the service you're requesting. Choose Browse all from the drop down menu to display all categories.
  5. In the Description field, enter a description for the service you need.
  6. To add child items or services, choose the Add Child Item button.
    Tip

    Child items can be catalog or non-catalog items and can be a product or service.

  7. Add the Expected Amount and Max Amount.
  8. Choose Add to cart.
  9. After you add the first item to the shopping cart, you can choose:
    OptionDescription

    Done

    Returns to the home page

    More options menu () > Create new

    Clears the page and allows you to create another non-catalog line and add it to the shopping cart

    More options menu () > Copy

    Leaves the existing information on the page and allows you to edit it to create another non-catalog line
  10. Choose Check out.
  11. To see additional fields, choose the right arrow to expand a line item. Edit fields that have incorrect information.
  12. Choose Submit.
  13. A confirmation dialog box displays. Choose Done to go to the home page.
